verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents enforcing a specific 2-Step Verification method for chosen users or groups. Its example is requiring a Sales team to use security keys, so hardware-key MFA beyond push codes can be mandated by policy. The evidence never mentions passkeys or FIDO2 by name. It also shows no way to require that strong method for specific sensitive apps: Context-Aware Access controls app access by identity, location, device and IP, not by authenticator type. missing for 10: passkey support evidence, explicit FIDO2 naming, per-app (sensitive-app) step-up enforcement of security keys, independent corroboration.
